data.description:
## Incident Overview

The test `test_debug_tracking_written_phase_f_and_g` in `tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-branch-tracking.sh` fails on Linux/GitHub Actions CI but passes on macOS.

**Symptom**: `phase_g_has` remains empty (not set to "yes") on Linux; test reports FAIL with actual: missing.

**Added in commit**: a25ae29386 (added `set -uo pipefail` to test file as part of PR review fixes)

**Affected line**:
```bash
if awk '/## Phase G/,/## Phase H|## Phase I|$/' "$SKILL_FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING"; then
```

**Platform difference**: GNU awk (Linux) treats `|` as regex alternation; BSD awk (macOS) treats `|` as literal. The stop pattern `/## Phase H|## Phase I|$/` with `$` (end-of-line) as an alternative may interact with `pipefail` differently on Linux.
data.title: [test-debug-everything-branch-tracking]: GNU awk handles pipe alternation in range stop pattern differently than BSD awk -> Phase G section check returns empty on Linux
